Title: Istoria del Concilio di Trento, scritta dal padre Sforza Pallavicino della Compagnia di Gesù, ora Cardinale della Santa Romana Chiesa, ove insieme rifiutasi con autorevoli testimonianze un'istoria falsa divolgata nello stesso argomento sotto nome di Pietro Soave Polano; nuovamente ritoccata dall'autore e divisa in tre volumi: PARTE TERZA
Creator: Sforza Pallavicino (1607-1667)
Publisher: In Roma: per Biagio Diversin e Felice Cesaretti, librari all'Insegna della Regina, MDCLXIV (1664), the author's revised edition in three parts; the first edition appeared in 1656-1657
Publication Date: 1664
Rights: Public Domain (published 1664; public domain by date)
Language: ita
Source: Internet Archive item india.history.resource.74738 (Asiatic Society of Bombay copy, digitised with Government of Maharashtra assistance), file 74738_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: none (the item carries no possible-copyright-status or licence field and no access restriction).
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged, no long-s characters present (0 replaced; the OCR renders long s as f, as in "fopra"). Rights basis in one checkable sentence: the title page in the OCR reads "IN ROMA, MDCLXIV", so the volume was published in 1664, long before the 1930 cutoff of the project's rolling 95-year rule.
Content note: PARTE TERZA of the three-part 1664 edition, Libri XVII-XXIV. Pallavicino's history was written to answer Sarpi's Istoria (the English Sarpi is vendored as sarpi_history-of-the-council-of-trent_brent1676.txt); it is a pro-Curia narrative (the label used in this world's Source Readiness Dossier) by a Jesuit who by the title page had become a cardinal, written after the Council and not a record made at it. OCR quality: mixed Italian print: readable at 10, 30 and 50 percent, badly garbled at 70 and 90 percent; second witness until a cleaner scan of this volume is vendored. Whole-file share of word-shaped tokens: 0.71. No English translation of Pallavicino's history exists in the Internet Archive (search of 2026-10-16), so there is no English beside this Italian.
